title: Natural and Mechanical Entropy: Intention Detection via Episenter–Resonance Analysis in Information Systems
abstract: Defines an operational, agent-free measure of structural intention as the KL-divergence between observed outputs and a system’s own baseline dynamics. Proposes an episenter–resonance detection framework with three diagnostics (episenter concentration, resonance spectrum ratio, cross-regime asymmetry) to distinguish natural from mechanically injected entropy, and outlines case studies and an empirical protocol for LLMs with falsifiable predictions.
